title: Stanford CS231N | Spring 2025 | Lecture 9: Object Detection, Image Segmentation, Visualizing
description:
For more information about Stanford's online Artificial Intelligence programs visit: https://stanford.io/ai

This lecture covers:
1. Single-stage detectors
2. Two-stage detectors
3. Semantic/Instance/Panoptic segmentation
4. Feature visualization and inversion
5. Adversarial examples
6. DeepDream and style transfer

To learn more about enrolling in this course visit: https://online.stanford.edu/courses/cs231n-deep-learning-computer-vision
